name: hanik-portfolio-motion
description: Remotion source for the rendered clips in public/media. Not part of the Next.js build.

scripts.poster: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts FloodRise out/poster.png --frame=96
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts FloodRise out/flood.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=30 --pixel-format=yuv420p --muted && remotion render src/index.ts FloodRise out/flood.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=36 --muted
